entry.title: Share a little of the cleanup
entry.summary: At a meal already underway, offer a cloth and let your baby join a small part of wiping. You can finish what still needs doing.
entry.cue: Your baby is interested in the cloth or in your wiping movement.
detail: The authors describe a cloth for hands and mouth and a little shared table wiping. Their eight-month-old example is imperfect, with the adult still doing cleanup.
This is participation in an ordinary moment, not a task your baby needs to finish.
